rationale: No detector produced an AI-related finding from the evidence that was available.
Absence of markers does not show that no AI tools were used; markers are easy to remove.
aiOrigin.disclaimer: These categories summarise observable evidence; they are not calibrated probabilities. A website's origin generally cannot be established from its public frontend alone: human developers use AI tools, AI tools emit conventional code, and markers can be removed or left behind.
